title: Urea
description: Bulk supply of agricultural-grade urea fertilizer sourced from established producers and delivered through international commodity logistics networks.
overview:
AFGT supplies agricultural-grade urea fertilizer sourced from established producers across major fertilizer-exporting regions. The company coordinates bulk procurement, logistics, and delivery for agricultural distributors, fertilizer traders, and institutional buyers.

All urea products are supplied with full specification documentation, quality certification, and shipment traceability to ensure compliance with international fertilizer standards.
